title: Target uses unencrypted HTTP
description: The observed target URL uses HTTP, so the request and its response were not protected by TLS. Credentials, cookies, and page content cross the network in cleartext.
remediation: Serve the application over HTTPS and redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Add HSTS once HTTPS is stable.
limitation: Decided from the observed URL scheme only. HTTPS targets with broken certificates are out of scope for this check.
